full_judgment: 7. It appears that the petitioner and another Director Bashir Ahmed were removed from the office of Director by an extra-ordinary general meeting of the company held on 31.12.78. The respondent-company has filed a list of documents and has annexed a photostat copy of the minutes of the said meeting signed by the members of the company and the Chairman of the meeting. Under section 83(2) of the Companies Act there is a presumption attached to this document, until the contrary is 'proved'. The petitioner has not 'proved' that the minutes of the proceedings of the extra-ordinary general meeting of the company held on 31.12.78 are not correct. The petitioner alleges that the company is functioning with-out any Board of Directors and the respondent-company insists that it is functioning through a validly constituted Board of Directors. Under Article 32 of the Articles of Association the number of Directors shall not be less than 3 and it appears that the company is functioning with the minimum of 3 directors including the Managing Director, after removal of the petitioner and the other Director Bashir Ahmed on 31.12.78. It is therefore not correct to say that the company has no Board of Directors.
